notes.title: Bugfix
notes.notes:
I watched an Origami Flight gameplay video and noticed some bugs. Since a lot of people decide to give Origami Flight a chance during the holidays, I removed the rust from the code and tried to fix the following bugs (which I believed was sucessful):


 Localization bug on non supported languages.
 Final Boss sound effects on loop.


Wish you all happy holidays and that 2021 be a better year.
If everything goes fine, I might fix some other bugs in the near future.
Don't forget to report any you find!
Thanks!

notes.title: New release date: April 1st
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

Due to technical issues, we'll have to postpone Origami Flight's release in two weeks. It's sad, but it's for the best! 

We know, we know, new release data is on April's fool, but we won't trick you! We promise...! ːsteammockingː

notes.title: We have a release date!
notes.notes:
Hi everybody!

We finally have a release date! Hope you stay tuned for more info about the game! I promise I'll keep you updated!

Cheers,
Sid
